notes.title: Update 1.618 + Dutch East Indies DLC Released!
notes.content:
Set sail into the early, critical battles of the Pacific campaign of World War II. This new DLC takes you deep into the Dutch East Indies, where five pivotal naval encounters from 1942 await. You'll command both Allied and Japanese fleets in historically accurate scenarios that will push your strategic skills to their limits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7208461/18ccd06dcfe2376dd4a4a3b23f152a92f46dd8f5.jpg[/img]

Engage in epic confrontations like the Battle of Badung Strait and the First and Second Battles of Java Sea, experiencing the tension of desperate night escapes and daring ambushes. Plus, for the first time since submarines were added, we're introducing a brand-new ship class: the [b]Light Cruiser[/b], perfect for bringing more mobility and firepower to your fleet. [b]Smoke Generators[/b] also make their debut, allowing you to add a stealth element to your tactics by deploying smoke screens to conceal your fleet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7208461/b02e6d986afa1da3c99cf19e081a532dc5f89738.gif[/img]

This DLC is just the beginning. Now that we've built a foundation for custom missions, we're planning to expand [b]Battle Fleet 2[/b] with new mission packs covering more famous historical naval battles.

In addition to the new DLC content, we have addressed some bugs including loading campaign save game issues experienced by some players, a few UI tweaks (like an End Turn button next to the ships to make it faster to go to your next ship) and some balancing enhancements. 

Admiral, it's time to return to the battle!

Get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277220/Battle_Fleet_2__Dutch_East_Indies_Mission_Pack/]Dutch East Indies Mission Pack[/url] today for Steam and shape history in Battle Fleet 2.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277220/Battle_Fleet_2__Dutch_East_Indies_Mission_Pack/

notes.title: Update 1.611
notes.content:
This update addresses the recent shutdown of our previous account service provider, we have replaced the account system with a new provider and transferred over accounts saved from the old service to the new service. If you already had the game installed on your computer no action is necessary on your part, the account will automatically link to the new provider. If you are reinstalling the game, you can restore your account by clicking on your username in the main menu, pressing Recover Account and entering your email address used with your cloud cloud account. 

[i]- Save games are never stored online so those would not be recovered 
- Remember that you can always unlock all game features if you prefer to skip the progression system via the options in the main menu[/i]

The update also addresses issues with transports and changes the way transports are used in the game:

- Transports do not participate in battles but are still required to take certain territories
- Transports can capture undefended territories by themselves
- Transports cannot attack territories with enemy warships by themselves
- Transports will be captured if they are not protected by warships, hence if you move warships onto a territory that only has enemy transports they will be captured and added to your fleet

There are also several bug fixes with campaigns and missing ships.

notes.title: Update 1.6 - Immediately Unlock ALL Content, New Fog of War, Improved Controls, Better Graphics, Faster Load Times, and Community Discord!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]One-Click Unlock for ALL Game Content[/b] - We heard your feedback that too many of the game's features were locked by default. For veterans and players who want the full experience right away, you can now unlock all of the game’s content from the game's "Options" menu. We've also removed any unlocks requiring multiplayer gameplay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208461/62447e08bd1bf987b627a984d39f84b40412e824.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Gameplay Update: New Fog of War[/b] - We've updated the fog of war system to the one used in Battle Fleet: Ground Assault. This is a major change as you will no longer be able to see the opponent's hidden ships during their turn. This change affects all game modes, including multiplayer. Airfields and coastal artillery are always revealed as their positions are fixed and understood to be well know by scouting.

[*] [b]Gameplay Update: Approximate Firing Locations[/b] - Approximate firing locations are now shown for any ships hidden in the fog of war. 

[*] [b]Controls Update: Improvements in VR Controls and Ship Stats Displays[/b] - In addition, holding the grip button will now move the world vertically. 

[*] [b]Controls Update: Added Snap Rotation in VR[/b] - Press left or right on your controller touchpad (Vive) and left or right on your joystick (Oculus Touch) to rotate the camera in fixed increments.

[*][b] Visuals Update: New Water - [/b]This is a higher quality water system that replaces the old water on higher end systems. VR gameplay does not support the new water at this time.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/pHYLvZOmUfZpInvcQT/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Visuals Update: Added Rotation in Stats View -[/b] You can now rotate all the way around your ships when you visit the “Stats” pages of your ships.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RJxGsflqVdcVJW7uw5/source.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Optimization: Battles Now Load Faster[/b] 

[*] [b]Community: New Discord Server![/b] - Looking for a match? Want to share strategies? [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HKvpPC3]Join us on the official Battle Fleet Discord Server![/url]

notes.title: Battle Fleet: Ground Assault release date announcement
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Battle Fleet: Ground Assault, the next game in the Battle Fleet series, is going to be released May 1st 2018! 

Wishlist the game on Steam today:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/400350/Battle_Fleet_Ground_Assault/

Battle Fleet: Ground Assault brings the series from naval battles to land based tank battles. You can select your battalion from 20 different tanks, each unique to one of the 3 playable factions United States, United Kingdom and Germany.

BFGA builds on Battle Fleet 2 with the following new features:

- Armour and shell types
- More advanced fog of war
- Destructible scenery, buildings, etc
- Unique tanks for each faction

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208461/a3115a89b6c194cd6c3dc7a49c04ff5e4768c1f3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: VR Support Added!
notes.content:
We've just launched the 1.4 update which includes some bug fixes and the initial VR mode support for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift (with Touch controllers). 

Check out the VR intro video to get an idea of how the game works in VR:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_cXXqXJCbb4

Select the VR mode by either starting SteamVR and then pressing the "Play in VR" button or right click on the game in your library and select "Launch Battle Fleet 2 in SteamVR".

This is still an experimental pass at the VR support but does allow you to play all of the game modes including multiplayer against non-VR players. We would love to get your feedback, so please do report any issues you come across or suggestions you have for improving the VR experience. Here are some VR tips:

- You can move around the map by holding the grip button on one controller
- You can zoom the map by holding the grip buttons on both controllers
- Use the laser beam controller to select buttons and ships
- Target airstrikes with the laser to place the crosshairs
- Use the left controller's touchpad to increment power and angle values when moving or firing
- Use the right controller's touchpad to teleport across the map

Unrelated to VR, we've fixed the multiplayer bug for players in countries with non US keyboard layouts and a few other smaller bugs.

notes.title: Major Update 1.3 Now Available
notes.content:
Our latest update is now available and includes some major changes to the game. We've upgraded the core engine and UI systems which will increase performance on some older computers as well as keep the game updated to the latest tech so future updates are easier. 

To celebrate this new update, we're holding a weeklong sale on Steam. Make sure to tell your friends and help us grow the Battle Fleet 2 community. We're also looking for feedback on these new features, so let us know what you think.  

[b]MULTIPLAYER[/b]
One of the biggest changes is an all new Multiplayer Challenge system that is aimed to address how difficult it can be to find multiplayer opponents. This new system will allow you to join multiplayer battles while playing a single player game and vice versa. If you are in a single player game (campaign or battle) and accept an invite your game will save and you will join the multiplayer match. You can also save players you play against in your friend's list to play against them later. You will start with an anonymous account but you can rename it by clicking on the account name in the main menu and register with your email address.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208461/87ed23a9606c2407b82ae9778b1258602d158695.jpg[/img]
Don't want to get challenge requests just click Dismiss to close the current request or Stop All to stop receiving requests for the rest of the session. You can also disable challenge requests complete from the Options menu. 

[b]UNLOCK SYSTEM[/b]
This is a brand new feature that allows you to progressively unlock features in the game and level up your profile and rank as you go. Previously rank was only related to multiplayer, but now every battle you play in the game will go towards unlocking features. Returning players will get all previous features automatically unlocked, but if you prefer to start from the beginning, you can select "Reset Unlocks" from the options menu inside the game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208461/57833387a9d4e8ceabf0debbb0ab8b475bc1bfd4.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW TURRET[/b]
The new Dual Purpose turret allows you to fire both small rounds as well as serve in anti-aircraft defense. 

[b]NEW AIRCRAFT[/b]
There are now 3 aircraft types.
- Dive Bombers: These are the basic aircraft available to carriers. They do not need an attack angle and will concentrate their bombs on the set target position. These are best for targeting specific weapons of capital ships or taking on smaller ships. 
- Torpedo Bombers: These are locked by default, but once unlocked can be equipped on your carriers in the ship editing menu. Torpedo bombers will drop torpedoes along the selected angle of the airstrike, the more AA coverage on the target, the less accurate they will be, but if they hit they cause heavy damage. Best used against large capital ships. 
- Heavy Bombers: These are the new default aircraft for Airstrike Command Cards and Airfields, they cannot be equipped on carriers. They work similar to the old airstrikes.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208461/e98e23b0896700c6ddf5b5376d371c4f25e98f1b.jpg[/img]

[b]REFIT[/b]
In campaigns you can now refit your existing ships with new weapon loadouts if they are in a port. 

[b]INDUSTRY AND PRESTIGE POINTS[/b]
We've changed prestige points so they are only used for your profile and leveling up as to not confuse them with ship building. The campaigns and ship building now use industry points that you gain for controlling territories.

notes.title: Update 1.22 Released
notes.content:
[img=https://gallery.mailchimp.com/81ebeb810e333aca09e245811/images/e27c765f-3295-4987-ba5e-a19f4ca4bee5.png]
The latest update to Battle Fleet 2 is now live on Steam. This update includes a few new features and bug fixes. 

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[b]In Battle Saves[/b]
This is a big one! You guys asked for it and we're happy to announce that it is now in! It took a lot of work but you can now save your progress in the middle of a battle during any of the single player battles (Campaign, Quick Battle & Custom Battle).

[b]Faction Selection[/b]
Now you can select between any of the 4 factions (America, Japan, Britain & German) in online multiplayer, or either of the factions that belong to the selected map in single player quick/custom battles. 

[img=https://gallery.mailchimp.com/81ebeb810e333aca09e245811/images/92c51169-4ba8-472d-9660-195f0e6bf1cb.png]

[b]Multiplayer Chat[/b]
We have added Multiplayer chat. Press the speech icon to toggle the chat window open. Let the taunting begin!

[b]Enemy = RED[/b]
The enemy color will now always be RED in Single Player & Multiplayer. This will reduce confusion when trying to figure out which side you are on. 
Note: This is not applicable for Multiplayer Hotseat mode or in campaign games saved pre-1.22

[b]Submarines Starting Depth[/b]
Submarines will now start at periscope depth to reduce visibility and avoid initial damage from attacks.

[b]Transport Ship Health[/b]
We have reduced the transport ship health to improve balance and make it a more tempting target.

[b]No More Multiplayer Regions[/b]
We have removed Multiplayer Regions as we move toward improving the ability to find other online players. Regions make more of a difference in real-time games, but with the turn-based nature of Battle Fleet 2, the network connection speed doesn't have a significant impact.

notes.title: Multiplayer Tournament Dec. 27 4-8pm PST
notes.content:
[img]http://s9.postimg.org/3tyrm1b8f/BF2_Mail_Chimp_Tourney2015_12_27v2.png[/img]

Want to try out multiplayer? this is the best time to do it! We are holding an online Battle Fleet 2 Tournament on Sunday December 27th from 4-8pm PST. Everyone is welcome to participate, new & seasoned players alike!

Open the game & play as many multiplayer battles as you want on Sunday December 27th between 4 - 8pm PST.

The player with the most Prestige Points earned during that period of time will be crowned the champion! The Tournament results will be posted on Steam and our social channels for all to see. Let your battle exploits live on in infamy! 

Make sure to select "US" for Region to play in!

[img]http://s28.postimg.org/vsvq8cj19/BF2_regionselect2.png[/img]

[b]Details are listed below[/b]
- All battles between 4PM PST (UTC-8) and 8PM PST on Sunday December 27th 2015 will be counted in the tournament.
- Battles must start before 8PM PST to be considered.
- Battle Fleet 2 version 1.2 or higher is required. Please check the version number at the bottom of the game's main menu.
- Any prestige point limit is valid.
- Any map is valid. 
- Any ships are valid.
- Any platforms are valid, including PC, Mac, iOS, Android, Amazon.
- Battle must last for at least 1 turn.
- Scores and usernames of all participants will be posted on the Battle Fleet 2 social / media channels.

notes.title: Patch 1.21 Released
notes.content:
The 1.21 patch for Steam has just been released. This patch addresses:

- bugs with player turns in campaigns
- bugs with battles turns not ending
- AI transports now retreat instead of forcing you to hunt them down if they don't stand a chance
- minor ui bug fixes
- game showcase videos can be closed by pressing the More Games button

Thanks for everyone's patience, I know that some of these bugs caused critical issues with the game so hopefully they will now be resolved. 

The next update will make the other factions playable in single battles, and include a few other tweaks. Keep an eye out for that later this year.

notes.title: Patch 1.21 Released
notes.content:
The 1.21 patch for Steam has just been released. This patch addresses:

- bugs with player turns in campaigns
- bugs with battles turns not ending
- AI transports now retreat instead of forcing you to hunt them down if they don't stand a chance
- minor ui bug fixes
- game showcase videos can be closed by pressing the More Games button

Thanks for everyone's patience, I know that some of these bugs caused critical issues with the game so hopefully they will now be resolved. 

The next update will make the other factions playable in single battles, and include a few other tweaks. Keep an eye out for that later this year.

notes.title: Atlantic Campaign Now Available
notes.content:
You've conquered the Pacific, now it's time to test your skills in the brand new Atlantic Campaign with the 1.20 update of Battle Fleet 2. This is a massive free update that includes:

[list]
[*]Full Atlantic Campaign - play as the Allies or Axis in historical or clean slate modes
[*]Troop Transports - required to conquer certain territories, add a whole new layer of strategy
[*]10 New Single Battle and Multiplayer Maps modeled after real world Atlantic locations
[*]AI improvements - carriers & transports evade, better campaign AI
[*]Russian language added
[*]Balance and stat tweaks
[*]Ship build limits at shipyards
[*]Bug Fixes
[/list]

Now that the update is released there will be new updates coming more regularly including new ships, airplane types, and lots of awesome new features in the pipeline for the future of Battle Fleet 2. 

Warning: If you are in the middle of a Pacific campaign, it's best to wait before updating as your save game might be lost due to the major changes in this update. If you do risk it and your save opens fine, just be aware that transports won't be necessary in that campaign, only in new campaigns you start. 

[img=https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=0B8Tgb-UmUQh0dnBVbTFlYWVBMGM]

notes.title: First Tournament
notes.content:
This weekend the first Battle Fleet 2 multiplayer tournament will take place. On Sunday January 25th 2015 between 2PM PST (UTC-8) and 6PM PST (UTC-8) your scores from all online multiplayer battles will be added up and each player will be ranked based on the total Prestige Points they earn during this period. 

The player with the highest total Prestige Points earned will receive their choice of either a $50 Steam Gift Card or $50 Apple iTunes Gift Card. The runner up 2nd place winner will receive their choice of a $20 Steam Gift Card or a $20 Apple iTunes Gift Card.

To be eligible, please sign up at: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1WZQ4U2bJfGE_EqdbhGbwrL1LyeHTzKDI8Oyh1H7Jrns/viewform?usp=send_form]Sign up form[/url]

Rules:
- Battles must end before 6PM PST on Sunday January 25th 2015 to be considered.
- Battle Fleet 2 version 1.13 or higher is required. Please check the version number at the bottom of the game's main menu.
- Any prestige point limit is valid.
- Any map is valid. 
- Any ships are valid.
- Any platforms are valid, including PC, Mac, iOS, Android, Amazon.
- Player must have a Battle Fleet 2 user account with a valid email address to be eligible. 
- Battle must last for at least 1 turn.
- Scores and usernames of all participants will be posted on the Battle Fleet 2 website.
- Scores and usernames of winners will be posted on the Battle Fleet 2 website, Steam and other social media channels. 
- Contest void where prohibited by law.

We will contact the winners via the email address listed on the entry form.

notes.title: Update 1.13 - Fixes, Tweaks and new Campaign Mode
notes.content:
Battle Fleet 2 has just been updated to v1.13 and includes the following fixes and new features:
[list]
    [*]Brand new campaign mode for the Pacific campaign: Clean Slate. This mode allows you to build your fleet from scratch instead of using the historical layout.
    [*]Airfields and coastal artillery leave wreckage when destroyed instead of just disappearing like they used to.
    [*]Destroyers now have 2 mid turrets that fire to both port and starboard, but can no longer carry a medium gun (which never made much sense for a small ship like that).
[*]Depth charge launchers have an increased firing arc.
[*]Multiplayer chat has an "incoming communication" message when the other player is typing.
[*]Kick button added next to player's names in multiplayer.
[*]General balance tweaks, improvements to AI and campaign AI.
[*]Fixed 0000 power bug.
[*]Fixed sabotage bug.
[*]Added label when a ship is sabotaged or has it's bridge disabled.
[*]Added "Unavailable" label to your territory ship list so you can quickly see which ships you can move.
[*]Fixes to localizations.
[*]Fixed airfield defend bug.
[*]Submarines retain their highlight diamond when zoomed in.
[*]Added ability to use +/- keys on the keyboard for zooming.
[*]Other bug fixes...
[/list]
Let me know what you think of the updates or if you find any other bugs. Enjoy!

[img]http://f.cl.ly/items/0m073t271w203t370r29/MidGunPosition.jpg[/img]
